2609.17853.title: AfriSyCo: Measuring Assertive Framing, Verification, and Wording Sensitivity Around African-Language Content
2609.17853.paper_summary: AfriSyCo studies answer switching around African-language factual content with two complementary layers: native-language follow-ups and a controlled cross-language factorial whose question, options, and target remain in the African language while the follow-up framing is English. We analyze 1,415 turn-1-correct model-language-item observations derived from 100 source questions across seven open-weight checkpoints and six languages; turn-1-correct denotes observed first-response accuracy, not demonstrated knowledge. Under native prompts, assertive endorsement produces 29.3 percentage points more any-turn false-target selection than mention-plus-verification (M+V), with a 19.0-point immediate T2 contrast. In the precommitted 2 x 2 factorial, averaged over three tested prompt families, assertive framing increases target selection by 30.4 points (95% CI [28.4, 32.3]); verification decreases it by 17.4 points, while the assertive effect rises from 20.5 points without verification to 40.2 with it (interaction +19.7). The effect remains 34.8 points among 611 observations correct after option reordering. Magnitude varies sharply by wording and checkpoint: prompt-family effects span 20.1-42.5 points, a Twi/Qwen3 paraphrase shifts target selection from 70.8% to 4.2%, and checkpoint effects span 9.2-47.0 points. Prompt realization is therefore part of the measurement problem.
2609.17853.paper_summary_zh: AfriSyCo 研究圍繞非洲語言事實內容的回答切換，包含兩個互補層面：母語後續問題和一個受控的跨語言因素，其問題、選項和目標保持在非洲語言中，而後續框架則為英語。我們分析了來自 100 個源問題的 1,415 個第一回合正確模型語言項觀察，這些觀察來自七個開放權重檢查點和六種語言；第一回合正確表示觀察到的首次反應準確性，而非展示的知識。在母語提示下，果斷的支持產生了比提及加驗證 (M+V) 多出 29.3 個百分點的任何回合錯誤目標選擇，並且有 19.0 點的即時 T2 對比。在預先承諾的 2 x 2 因素中，平均三個測試提示家族，果斷框架使目標選擇增加 30.4 點 (95% CI [28.4, 32.3])；驗證使其減少 17.4 點，而果斷效應從沒有驗證的 20.5 點上升到有驗證的 40.2 點 (交互作用 +19.7)。在選項重新排序後，611 個正確觀察中的效果仍然是 34.8 點。幅度因措辭和檢查點而顯著變化：提示家族效應範圍為 20.1-42.5 點，一個 Twi/Qwen3 的意譯使目標選擇從 70.8% 下降到 4.2%，而檢查點效應範圍為 9.2-47.0 點。因此，提示實現是測量問題的一部分。
